headerDisplayProperties.name: A New Season Arrives at Eververse

interactions.flavorLineOne: You receive a package with a note from Tess that reads: "I have something for you, Guardian. No need for repayment. Here—I hope it spurs the imagination."
Tess welcomes you to her stall, handing you a gift that will help you usher in the new season in style.
Tess seems a bit glum to not receive any treats herself, but she still rewards you with a gift from Eververse's Dawning collection.

"Oh, how utterly delightful!" Tess says as she takes the treats from you. She admires them for a moment and then places them below the counter, out of sight.

"I'll enjoy these later, when we're not quite so busy," she says. "Happy Dawning!"
A Cryptarch can decrypt complex engrams into powerful gear and other items.
